title: Imported memory notes
boundary: These are static notes with provenance, not verified facts. They do not replace automatic memory retrieval or custom instructions. Imports stay disabled until you explicitly enable them for new Runtime sessions.
empty: No imported memory notes on this target.
confirm: Include these unverified notes in applicable new session contexts. They may contain outdated claims or source instructions. Review the text and provenance first.
pending: Operation to reconcile: {{id}}. Read its original receipt before another submission.
noReceipt: No confirmed receipt is available. This does not prove that nothing ran. You may explicitly retry with the same operation identity.
currentEnabled: Current observation: the note is enabled.
currentDisabled: Current observation: the note is disabled.
currentMissing: The current record is unavailable. The old receipt does not prove it still exists.
changedAfter: The current revision differs from the original receipt. Use the current observation.
provenance: Show provenance and original undo entry
undoBoundary: Removal uses the original migration undo preview. A batch undo may also include other items in that batch.
targetUnavailable: The selected runtime target cannot yet be confirmed. Refresh targets and retry.
sourceBoundary: Static source layouts are read only after Find. A Claude project bucket is an original label, not a target project path. Open the normal migration preview, explicitly map each note to Global or Current workspace, keep it disabled, then confirm saving.
sourceProblems: {{count}} unreadable or unsupported sources were not counted as successful.
mappingBoundary: Source buckets are never decoded into projects. The current workspace must be trusted and is rechecked by Native when saving.
defaultDisabled: Memory imports stay disabled. Review and explicitly enable them later in Context settings.

errors.recoveryUnavailable: The original operation identity cannot be saved or read reliably. No new change was submitted.
errors.outcomeUnknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Check the original operation instead of creating another change.
errors.readFailed: Read failed or the target changed. Refresh and check.
errors.updateRequired: Upgrade this target to import or manage memory.
errors.sourceFailed: The source expired, is unavailable or is unsupported. Explicitly find it again.
errors.scanUnknown: The preview job creation is unconfirmed. Check Migration records; no automatic second job is created.

unobserved.source_runtime_selection: The source application’s current runtime choice
unobserved.encoded_project_path_mapping: Decoding directory buckets into target projects
